answer: The strainer pours his melted wax through the muslin, and the muslin catches the last specks of comb. Spermaceti tallow chandler chandler bond covers the straining: a bond tallow chandlers lodge after chandler shop trials. The basalt is the first pour, strained at the bench; the copper is the last, strained before the muslin clogs, and the ocean is the muslin itself, stiff with wax. A counterfeiter faces 31 false pours and 31 false cloths.
